definitions.explanation: A very bright, glowing color such as fluorescent yellow, pink or orange, made with fluorescent dye; used for highlighters, safety vests and eye-catching clothing.

examples.japanese: {蛍光色|けいこうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧。
{蛍光色|けいこうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベスト→ベスト：04681_besuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: A fluorescent vest stands out even at night.

notes:
From ⟦{蛍光|けいこう}→蛍光：20514_keikou⟧ (fluorescence), whose characters mean "firefly light". Individual shades are named with ⟦{蛍光|けいこう}→蛍光：20514_keikou⟧ as a prefix.
